Actor Scott Eastwood joins Joe Rogan for episode 2519. Eastwood built a film career in the shadow of his father Clint. He favors rugged roles and outdoor life.

Rogan asks about growing up with a legend for a dad. Eastwood talks about work ethic, typecasting, and carving his own path. They share a love of training and the outdoors. The episode gives film fans a grounded star, more craftsman than celebrity. His plain talk about family and fame anchors the whole hour. Fame, in his telling, was never the goal. His manner stays easy under every question.

Strategist Elbridge Colby gives Tucker Carlson his advice to President Trump on avoiding a third world war. Colby, author of The Strategy of Denial, helped shape defense policy focused on China. His briefing here is sober, built on prioritizing real threats over endless commitments.

Colby explains why he thinks America's military must focus on Asia first. He addresses how Trump should handle the CIA and a bureaucracy used to its own agenda. Carlson tests the plan against Ukraine, Taiwan, and Iran. Serious and hopeful viewers get a clear strategy for peace through strength, from a top planner.
